description: This file defines the ReportingMethod entity class for the OrangeHRM system, representing reporting methods within the HRM database. It utilizes Doctrine ORM annotations for mapping the class to a relational database table, including properties for ID and name, as well as a relationship to ReportTo entities.

classes.name: ReportingMethod
classes.description: Entity class representing a reporting method used within the OrangeHRM system. It contains properties for ID and name, and manages a collection of related ReportTo entities.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the ID of the reporting method.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the ID of the reporting method.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the name of the reporting method.

methods.name: setName
methods.description: Sets the name of the reporting method.
